summary: Prioritize identifiable parts, ordered reveals and unambiguous labels while distinguishing sourced structure from authored simplification.
objective: Labels point to the intended part from the supported view and displacement for explanation is not confused with the assembled geometry.
intent_signals: Explain parts with controlled reveals and clear labels
example_prompts: Create a technical exploded-camera illustration with leader lines and a reset to the assembled body.

principles: Prioritize identifiable parts, ordered reveals and unambiguous labels while distinguishing sourced structure from authored simplification.
implementation: Model the features needed by the explanation; choose cutaway or exploded offsets that retain stable part identities and an assembly reference.
Use restrained surface color, clear edge contrast and broad lighting that supports part separation.
Provide a repeatable camera and controlled reveal steps; offer reset to the assembled state and avoid decorative movement during a reading task.

Explode along one declared axis: offset each part by 1.5x its own bounding depth, animate over 800 ms cubic in-out with a 200 ms stagger, and keep a dashed 0.75 px leader from each part back to its seated position so reset is unambiguous.

Render flat MeshBasicMaterial fills with an outline pass at 1.5 px on silhouettes and 0.75 px on interior edges; with Neutral tone mapping at exposure 1.0 and no lights, the on-screen part colour equals its legend swatch exactly.
observable_checks: Labels point to the intended part from the supported view and displacement for explanation is not confused with the assembled geometry.

defaults.rationale: An instructional plate is read, not admired, so the numbers make colour a label rather than an effect: unlit MeshBasicMaterial fills under Neutral tone mapping at exposure 1.0, no fog, no bloom, and exactly two saturated hues - one for the part under discussion, one for callouts - against a white page. The near-orthographic 24-degree lens and the 1.5x-bounding-depth explode offset exist so a reader can judge proportion and reassembly order without the perspective and shading cues that would make those judgements unreliable.

values.value_structure: 15/60/25 dark/mid/light on a white page; the discussed part is the only saturated region in frame
values.saturation_rule: greys stay <= 8% HSL; exactly two saturated hues, one for the focus part and one for annotation, never applied to the same element

key.note: MeshBasicMaterial flat fills plus an outline pass; with no shading a part's colour is exactly its assigned colour

lights.ratio: unlit - separation comes from outline weight (1.5 px silhouette, 0.75 px interior) and flat fill value, not from light

values.intensity_unit: three-intensity (lux-scaled for Directional/Hemisphere, candela for Point/Spot; tuned with the stated tone_mapping.exposure)

camera.projection: orthographic for the assembled plate; perspective at fov 24 only when overlap must be disambiguated

materials.notes: MeshBasicMaterial flat fills plus an inverted-hull or EdgesGeometry outline pass; each part keeps one constant colour so the reader can match it to the legend from any angle

values.signature_technique: an exploded view along a single declared axis, each part offset by 1.5x its own bounding depth with a dashed 0.75 px leader back to its seated position
never: perspective distortion that changes a proportion the reader must judge
confusing an exploded offset with the assembled geometry

known_limits: Values are authored starting points tuned for Neutral tone mapping at exposure 1.0 with unlit materials; re-tune every value if you introduce shading, a different tone mapping or a different exposure.
No renderer run for this record; values are authored starting points.
creative_affordances: Combine with monochrome, papercraft or stylized surfaces; measured dimensions and anatomical claims require their own source/geometry checks.
